name: Hanns-Seidel-Stiftung (HSS) Scholarship for International Students

universities: Any state or state-recognized university in Germany

eligibleNationalities: Open to international (non-German) students; no nationality restriction on the 'Förderung internationaler Studierender' / 'Scholarship for Studies' track. Applicants from countries with an HSS overseas office apply via that office; others apply directly through the online portal. Bangladesh is not excluded.
languageRequirements: Proof of German language skills of at least B2 or comparable level is mandatory for international students; applications without proof of German are not considered.
applicationFee: Free (application submitted via HSS online portal; no fee stated)
fundingCovers: Non-material support: seminars, individual mentoring, scholar/alumni network
monthlyStipend: Study scholarships: up to EUR 855/month plus a EUR 300/month study-cost allowance (Studienkostenpauschale). PhD scholarships: up to EUR 1,650/month plus EUR 100/month research-cost allowance.
postStudyWork: Not specified by HSS (general German post-study job-seeker residence rules apply, not part of this scholarship)
requiredDocuments: One-page exposé on study and career goals (PDF)
If available: Bachelor's/intermediate certificate and current transcript of records (PDF)
Proof(s) of voluntary/civic engagement (Ehrenamtsnachweis, combined into one PDF)
Expert opinion / academic reference (Fachgutachten) from a professor or qualified academic
If available: current enrollment or admission certificate (Immatrikulations-/Zulassungsbescheinigung; first-year students may submit later)
International students: proof of German language skills of at least B2 (mandatory)

timeline.deadline: 15 July 2026 (summer round) and 15 January 2027 (winter round) for 'Internationale Studierende und Promovierende (Ausländer)'
timeline.resultsBy: Applicants are informed of the outcome by e-mail approximately four weeks after the application deadline
timeline.notes: As of 2026-06, the official portal lists two open rounds: 15 June-15 July 2026 and 15 December 2026-15 January 2027, both explicitly open to 'Internationale Studierende und Promovierende (Ausländer)'. Suitable candidates are then invited to a selection meeting (Auswahltagung). Dates taken verbatim from the official application page (hss.de/stipendium/bewerbung/).

benefits: Study scholarship: up to EUR 855/month monthly stipend
Stipend is non-repayable (muss nicht zurückgezahlt werden)
Non-material support: seminars on politics/society/technology and personal development, individual mentoring by Vertrauensdozenten at the university
Lifelong access to the HSS scholar and alumni network
PhD track (if applicable): up to EUR 1,650/month plus EUR 100/month research-cost allowance
mustKnow: German language proficiency of at least B2 (or comparable) is MANDATORY for international applicants; applications without proof of German are rejected outright.
Age limit: applicants must be under 45 years old.

You must be enrolled in (or, for the study track, undertaking) a full-time programme at a state/state-recognized German university; in practice you secure a German university place first, then the scholarship (two-step).

HSS is the political foundation affiliated with Bavaria's CSU: applicants must show civic/political engagement, voluntary work, and support for democracy, rule of law and human rights, and affirm the foundation's goals.

Application route: if HSS has an office in your home country, apply via that office; otherwise apply directly through the online portal (https://stipendienbewerbung.hss.de/). Applications are accepted ONLY through the portal.
Two fixed application rounds per year (summer: 15 June-15 July; winter: 15 December-15 January). Applications for other programmes / outside these windows are deleted without notice.
Shortlisted candidates are invited to a selection meeting (Auswahltagung) judged by an independent committee — an interview/selection-event stage.
Funds living/study costs, not tuition (German state universities are generally tuition-free for master's). Confirm there is no tuition gap for your specific programme.
